title: Moser's Circle Problem: Counting Intersections and Pairs
full_prompt: Write a Manim scene named `CountIntersections` (or `ExplainNChoose2`) that visualizes the combinations of points on a circle. The scene should draw a circle with 7 points, draw chords between them, and sequentially highlight each pair of points and their connecting chord while displaying the corresponding coordinate pairs (e.g., (1, 2), (1, 3)...) in a grid on the right. After showing all pairs, it should display the formula '{n \choose 2}' with the label 'n choose 2', animate the count updating to 21, and show the algebraic calculation '= {7 \cdot (7 - 1) \over 2}'. Make sure to handle the layout gracefully so that the text labels do not overlap with the circle diagram.

common_failure_modes.note: The reference code relies on get_circle_diagram which is defined later in the file. Implementers must provide a robust circle and chord generator.

common_failure_modes.pattern: ManimGL-specific make_number_changeable API usage in ManimCE
common_failure_modes.note: Using make_number_changeable or ChangeDecimalToValue directly in ManimCE will crash. Use DecimalNumber and ValueTracker instead.
